title: account.deleted v1 payload
description: The account's 30-day deletion grace ended (the owner asked from Settings > Account after re-authenticating, then did not sign in again), so identity erased it: every personal field wiped, credentials, sessions and devices deleted; the row stays as a tombstone with status deleted. Emitted by identity's beat task in the erasure transaction; actor_id is null. Every service erases or anonymises what the account owns, idempotently; the account never comes back.
